content: Jwatolile na jwatolelwa
Mangota bhintolilwe, majhokanikiya akanganabhino, kupala anda abhii munalome jhojhoha jwangahobhelela lilobhe lya Chapanga, ajheketela papala kulola matyangilo ghino. Changapalwa kulonge chochoha,
nhwalo chalola matyangilo ghino chighabhii ghambone na gha ichima.
Kukilembekeya kwino kwangabhehe kwa panja tujhe ngita kuloka mangongo na kuwala chaabo na ngobho ya bei ngolongwa.
Nambo kukilembelekeya kwino kutumbulila nkate jha mwojho gwino, uhalano gwangatundungila, yenio ndi uhuke gwa uhengwa na unuu ndi kilebhe chambone hake palonge jha Chapanga.
Yene ndi chibhakilembanikiya akakeghe bha makacho bhibhahobholila Chapanga, bhakilembanikiya kwa kwajhokanikiya akangana bhabhe.
Ngita Chala panyokanikiya Ulahimo na pankemita unganamundo. Na mangota ngohe mmii akachikana mundo anda ntei ghaumbone changajhoghopa kilebhe chochoha.

Hele na mangota akanalome bhitolile, ntamangana na akaana bhino kongo umanye bheniya akaleghelau. Yene matendela kwa kwatembekeya nhwalo bhene hele nabhapokela pamonga na mangota hupo jha ughome gwampeke Chapanga. Peniya ndi kujhopa kwino nakujheketelwa.
Kung'ahika kwa kuhenga ghaumbone
Kukujhomolela nilonge naha, mma mwojho ghumo na nholela ghamo na mmonelana kiya, mpalane anda akalongo, mma akanuu na kunyenyekehana.
Mangalepechela bhando ubhoho kwa ubhoho anda jhe maligho kwa maligho, nambo majhopela mota, nhwalo mangota nkemitwe na Chapanga nhoto kupoke mota.
Ngita Majhandiko gha Chapanga chighalonge:

content.text: na lulime lwake lwangalonge jhe uwange.
Nhwalo miho gha Bhambo ghalolekeya bhando bhibhahenga ghaumbone
na machikilo ghake ujhokanikii kujhopa kwabhe,
nambo Bhambo abhalangii kihogho bhando bhibhahenga ghanganandela.”

content: Bho, ghane jwapala kumengwa mangota anda nnyendelii kuhenga ghaumbone?
Nambo anda mipalwa kung'ahika kwa nhwalo gwa kuhenga ghapala Chapanga, mina mota mangota. Mangampwele jhe mundo jhojhoha hilu mangabhehe jhe na kiholo.
Nambo mnnombe Kilichitu ngita Bhambo mu miojho jhino. Machiko ghoha nhoto kunnyanguu kila mundo jwapakunkonya nhwalo gwa manhobholelo ghino ghighabhii mu miojho jhino.

Nambo ntendengane yenio kwa unuu na ichima. Mma na mwojho gwangakilangii kubhehe na malemwa, kupala bhala bhibhanchonjola matyangii ghino ghaumbone anda bhando bhibhahobholela Kilichitu, bhabha na hone ndii.
Nambo mbaha kung'ahika kwa kuhenga ghaumbone, anda apahi Chapanga, kuliku kung'ahika kwa kuhenga ghanganandela.

Nhwalo Kilichitu ngang'ahika na kuwe malajhimo tu nhwalo gwa ubhoho gwa bhando bhoha, mundo jwamaha nga jhumo ngawila kwa nhwalo gwa bhando bhanganandela, kupala kumpeleka mangota palonge jha Chapanga. Ngakomitwa kiyegha nambo ngabhekwita kubhehe ghome kwa uhotolo gwa Uhuke gwa Chapanga,
na kwa ndela jha jhojho Uhuke gwa Chapanga ngajhenda kuitangachii ihuke hela ibhii mu kipungo.

Bheniya ndi bhibhankanita kuntembeke Chapanga pabhalendila kwa kwahimbilila kipinde cha Nuho palenganikiya chapina. Mu chapina jhene bhakajhingii bhando bhandina tu yane bhando nane tu bhibhakombolilwe mu mache,

mache gheniya ghalandanichwa na ubaticho ghukunkombo mangota ngohe. Na chi ubaticho ghukunda luku lwa payegha, nambo ndi lilaghano lya Chapanga lilitendike kwa mwojho gwambone kwa ndela jha kuyoka kwa Yecho Kilichitu.
Na jwenio ajhawii kunane kwa Chapanga na ngohe atamite lubhoko lwalelo lwa Chapanga. Ndi jwalongocha akatumiche bha kunane kwa Chapanga, na bhina kindendeke na bhina makakala ghoha.
